lifestyle_guidance.description: Provides general healthy lifestyle guidance that can support overall wellbeing. It does not replace individualized medical advice.

nutrition.title: Balanced Nutrition
recommendations: Eat balanced meals with a variety of foods.
Include vegetables and fruits regularly.
Choose whole grains when appropriate.
Include suitable sources of protein.
Aim for variety and moderation in food choices.
Consider individual dietary needs and medical conditions.

hydration.title: Hydration
recommendations: Drink fluids regularly according to your individual needs.
Pay attention to increased fluid needs during hot weather, exercise, or illness.
If you have a medical condition that affects fluid intake, follow professional medical advice.

physical_activity.title: Physical Activity
recommendations: Try to include regular physical activity appropriate for your ability and health status.
Start gradually if you are not used to exercising.
Choose activities that are comfortable and sustainable.
Stop and seek medical advice if exercise causes concerning symptoms.

sleep.title: Healthy Sleep
recommendations: Maintain a consistent sleep and wake schedule.
Create a comfortable and quiet sleeping environment.
Limit stimulating activities close to bedtime.
Avoid excessive caffeine, especially later in the day.
Allow enough time for sleep according to your individual needs.

tobacco_and_harmful_substances.title: Avoid Harmful Substances
recommendations: Avoid tobacco products.
Avoid harmful or unsafe substances.
Seek professional support if you are finding it difficult to stop using a harmful substance.

preventive_health.title: Preventive Healthcare
recommendations: Attend routine health checkups when appropriate.
Discuss age-appropriate screening with qualified healthcare professionals.
Keep recommended vaccinations up to date according to local healthcare guidance.
Discuss personal risk factors with a healthcare professional.

daily_wellbeing.title: Everyday Wellbeing
recommendations: Maintain regular daily routines when possible.
Make time for rest and relaxation.
Stay connected with supportive people.
Pay attention to changes in your physical and emotional wellbeing.

lifestyle_guidance.important_note: Lifestyle recommendations should be adapted to individual health needs. People with medical conditions, pregnancy, significant symptoms, or other special circumstances should seek appropriate professional advice.
